name: ormar-online-safe-model-schema-evolution
instr:
Add ORM-native schema evolution so applications can compare assembled model generations and safely apply the resulting physical database transition. Plans must be portable, deterministic, dependency-safe, and compatible with existing model behavior.

Every scalar, foreign-key, many-to-many, and virtual-through field transition describes its physical storage effect without inventing columns for reverse or through-only relations; aliases, named constraints, referential actions, indexes, uniqueness, defaults, nullability, generated or explicit through models, and self-reference direction retain their database meaning. `SchemaPlanner` exposes `plan(self, previous, current)`, fields expose `schema_delta(self, previous)`, and `Model.schema_diff` produces immutable, repeatable plans whose dependency order is forward for creation and reversed for removal without mutating either compared model graph. Ambiguous identities, unexecutable cycles, unsupported destructive changes, and direct physical `ThroughField` migration raise `SchemaPlanningError` from `ormar`, with `model`, `field`, and `operation_ids`; destructive work requires explicit permission. Execution preflights the entire plan, preserves its order, uses one migration scope while respecting caller-owned transactions, and reports every applied or skipped operation; a repeated operation id is skipped after its first application. Unsupported dialect operations and execution failures raise `SchemaExecutionError` from `ormar`, iden
